summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel (Live Patch 16 for SUSE Linux Enterprise Micro 6.0)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise Kernel 6.4.0-39.1 fixes one security issue

The following security issue was fixed:

- CVE-2026-23268: apparmor: fix unprivileged local user can do privileged policy management (bsc#1259859).
